spec_anchor: WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json IMP-0076: publisher trust levels derived from measurement, not popularity

evidence.claim: Computed trust levels for every fixture publisher equal the hand-derived millipoint arithmetic frozen in the fixture file (level + signed/conformance/advisory/provenance components + scoring_input_sha256 over the canonical scoring-keys blob only).

The gaming strategy (popularity inflation: downloads/stars/ratings/followers/default_trusted planted at absurd values) is DEFEATED - level, score, component vector and scoring_input_sha256 are unchanged, an independent no-import interpreter reproduces the score, a real conformance drop on a near-high publisher moves HIGH to MEDIUM, and UNRATED is never default-trusted.

controls.description: Absurd popularity inflation on the alice fixture must leave every trust output byte-identical; a REAL conformance drop on a near-high publisher must move the level (detector not silent in both directions).
controls.good: popularity-inflated twin is byte-identical to baseline (silent)

controls.description: A publisher with published_version_count=0 is UNRATED with null score, never DEFAULT-TRUSTED.
controls.bad: UNRATED with null score on the empty-history fixture

residuals.claim: trust-levels.schema.json is validated by the unit tests; the probe instruments re-derive the arithmetic numerically rather than by schema validation of the TrustLevel object.
residuals.settling_experiment: Add a jsonschema pass of compute_publisher_trust().as_dict() against tools/marketplace/schema/trust-levels.schema.json once the stdlib-platform shadow permits importing jsonschema from REPO cwd.

reviewer.scope: Proposed the popularity-inflation gaming strategy against the formula and ran it for real; recomputed the weighted average with an independent interpreter that does not import trust_levels.py; verified the live-detector control (real conformance drop moves HIGH->MEDIUM).
reviewer.notes: Reviewer obligation (catalog) satisfied: one gaming strategy proposed, executed and reported DEFETED with the live-detector control proving non-silence.

report: G-1 for IMP-0076: fixture arithmetic equals hand-derived millipoints; popularity gaming defeated; independent interpreter agrees; receipt closed SUCCESS by the probe2 instrument after a BLOCKED/reviewer-absent builder phase.
